basis: Static reverse engineering before judgement; ML and scanner findings are leads, not proof. No specimen code was executed.

samples.marker_line: Peecube 1.2.0: click messaging and mobile UA are neutral
evidence: manifest.json declares popup/link tools, media downloads, ad blocking, and site monitoring; content/core.js gates popup opening on the configured modifier plus contextmenu gesture.
background.js:syncNetRules derives mobile requestDomains only from user-configured mobile site rules; no default mobile rule exists. The DNR User-Agent change is a compatibility feature.

The clicked-URL conviction pooled document click listeners, anchor reads, and a cancelled-event runtime message from different files. It never proved a single global capture path or a surveillance sink.

background.js handles downloads and HLS assembly locally; AES-CBC decryption processes media segments. Screenshots, clipboard actions, and link previews serve user tools. Site monitoring hashes requested page text into extension storage and emits local notifications.

license.js verifies Ed25519 signatures for licenses and a fetched GitHub revocation JSON feed; it does not evaluate downloaded code. Trial/licensing state and usage counters are stored with extension storage.

pages/newtab.js uses bookmarks.getTree for its start-page UI. content/panels.js mentions SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT in platform detection; that reference does not make the extension a Squarespace application.

PE32 MSVC image; entry0 0x402674 calls main at 0x401cb0. Configuration at 0x404120 is 3: main calls 0x401900 (Active Setup/self-copy branch) then 0x401390 (self-delete). The collector filename does not establish WannaCry.

0x401900 generates a GUID-derived executable name, constructs a destination, obtains its current image path, and calls RegCreateKeyA at 0x401a26 and RegSetValueExA at 0x401a4b to install HKLM Active Setup Installed Components\<id>\StubPath. It reads its own image via fopen/fseek/ftell/fread, patches the copy, writes it with fwrite at 0x401b26, and launches the destination via CreateProcessA at 0x401b7e.

0x401390 obtains the current module short path and COMSPEC, constructs /c del with the module path, creates a hidden/suspended interpreter at 0x4014b8, adjusts priorities, and resumes the deletion thread at 0x4014d9.

0x401150 creates a target process (calc/notepad/iexplore selection via 0x4010c0), allocates remote memory at 0x4011d1, writes a DLL path at 0x4011f5, resolves LoadLibraryA, and passes it as the CreateRemoteThread entry at 0x40123d.

Alternate modes include LanmanServer ServiceDLL registry replacement and service-installation code. 0x402460 contains the FindResource/SizeofResource/LoadResource/LockResource extraction and file-write path.

The .rsrc raw range 0x5000..0xec60 is entirely zero-filled, including its resource table. The embedded DLL is absent; extraction therefore cannot supply a working payload from these bytes. Preserve the code-level loader findings, without claiming successful DDoS, ransomware, a live C2 channel, or executed DLL payload.

The retained concrete self-install/autorun and self-delete paths, plus DLL-injector code and family-specific markers, support MALICIOUS despite the damaged payload. The supplied 63/71 VT and high Triage score corroborate, but did not substitute for disassembly.

samples.marker_line: Steedos workflow 3.0.120: fix Lodash escapes and URI field map
evidence: The archive SHA-512 integrity equals the official npm registry dist.integrity. package.json has no install lifecycle hook; its entry is package.service.js, a Moleculer/Steedos workflow service.

package.service.js registers workflow actions and widgets. Configured cron workers handle instance records, webhook queues, and timeout submission. src/webhook_queue.js sends workflow state to the configured payload_url through axios.

The AI design route authenticates via @steedos/auth, reads the operator-configured WORKFLOW_AI_API_KEY, and sends requested workflow-design input to a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint. These env reads and requests are ordinary application functionality.

Dynamic evaluation processes configured workflow expressions, field maps, and template adaptors. The packed designer asset contains identifiable jQuery/JSON parser code, SproutCore/CloudKit UI code, and URI.js accessors; the examined eval/new Function paths implement those features.

The alleged hardcoded credential record at packed-JS byte 1076020 is a URI accessor selector map: protocol:"protocol", username:"username", password:"password", hostname:"hostname", port:"port". It contains field labels, not service credential values.

The bundled CAB contains Apple iCloud Web App Plugin 1.0.24.0 (iCloud.ocx, SHA-256 47bc0d1224eb000c960c54d689ea9034d7232b540c1ceeba297ac6174cfff83f). Its Authenticode signature cryptographically verifies. The CAB INF describes ActiveX COM registration; disassembly of 0x1000d080/0x1000d190 shows the paired registration/unregistration paths. The designer selects this control for its legacy ActiveX view.

The followed dependency pkg:npm/lodash@4.18.1 was scanned independently before and after. _unicodeWords.js constructs Unicode character ranges and a RegExp, then exports a function returning string.match(reUnicodeWord)||[]. Its hex escapes represent character classes, not concealed executable code.

trait_changes.effect: Preserve the four positive roles and archive scope as a notable co-occurrence; remove the unproved collection/every-click inference and no longer hide the observation with the download exception.
Preserve matcher and notable severity; describe the header operation without claiming session-rule API use.
Remove the unsupported hostile inference and its now-unused mobile-window exception. The header action and Mobile Safari literal remain independently notable.
Move unchanged API matcher to data access; update the sensitive-browsing-data consumer.
Preserve matcher, scope, notable severity, and exclusions; remove unsupported obfuscation ATT&CK/MBC labels and update Nemucod consumer.
Preserve annotation matchers; keep the two-polarity fixture composite with exact new references. Isolated correction comments no longer satisfy broad test-harness selectors.
Preserve co-occurrence matchers and update consumers; remove unsupported URL value-flow, HTTPS-only, and install-time launch wording.

Consolidate overlapping curl identity observations to leave the UA leaf at 100 rules. Add Rust scope to the canonical matcher; its broader curl/version reference coverage on Rust is intentional. Preserve consumers and deduplicate the Yandex any clause.
Require a parsed assignment to Static.SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT instead of a bare mention in a platform detector.
Reject all-label host/auth selector maps. Retain all six property orders and single-label hosts with actual auth values by requiring at least one value outside its field-label vocabulary.
Add a notable structured WebCrypto signature/MAC verification call observation. The matcher does not infer asymmetric crypto from verify alone.

controls.coverage: Mobile header compatibility and literal near miss; cross-file click evidence; bookmark API placement; WebCrypto call versus string mention; URI selector map versus real credential records in six orders and local host aliases; Squarespace assignment versus detector mention; comment placement; Unicode character ranges; tab/install co-occurrence; canonical Rust curl coverage.

limitations: Large bundles have flow-budget/producer gaps; their relevant paths were reviewed directly.
Static capabilities are not proof that Windows API calls succeed. The StormAttack resource section is empty.
